name: generic_workday_hedged_alert_is_wrong_password
text: You may have entered the wrong email address or password or your account might be locked.
spec: AND any hedged or conditional lock mention from rule 1 (alone or with other words), e.g. "You may have entered the wrong email address or password or your account might be locked." and "Your account might be locked." are both wrong_password.

name: definite_has_been_locked
spec: "locked": the text says definitely that the account IS locked, disabled or suspended ... ("Your account has been locked", "Account locked", ...)

name: hedged_might_be_locked_alone
spec: A hedged or conditional mention is NOT a lock: "might be locked", "may be locked", "could be locked" ... "Your account might be locked." are both wrong_password.

name: account_locked_short
spec: "locked": the text says definitely that the account IS locked ... ("Your account has been locked", "Account locked", ...)

name: temporarily_disabled_is_locked
spec: "locked": the text says definitely that the account IS locked, disabled or suspended ... ("Your account is temporarily disabled", ...)

name: too_many_failed_attempts_is_locked
text: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 30 minutes
spec: "locked": the text says definitely ... that there WERE too many (failed) sign-in attempts ("Too many failed attempts. Try again in 30 minutes", ...)

name: locked_out_is_locked
spec: "locked": the text says definitely that the account IS locked, disabled or suspended ... ("You have been locked out")

name: conditional_if_locked_contact_support
text: If your account is locked, contact support
spec: A hedged or conditional mention is NOT a lock: ... "if your account is locked, contact support" ... are both wrong_password.

name: future_warning_will_be_locked
text: After 5 failed attempts your account will be locked
spec: A hedged or conditional mention is NOT a lock: ... "after 5 failed attempts your account will be locked" (a warning about the future).

name: email_already_exists
text: An account with this email address already exists
spec: "exists": an account with this e-mail already exists ("already exists", "already in use", "already registered", "An account with this email address already exists").

name: already_in_use_is_exists
text: This email is already in use
spec: "exists": an account with this e-mail already exists ("already exists", "already in use", "already registered", ...).

name: please_verify_account
text: Please verify your account before you sign in
spec: "verify": the tenant asks to verify / activate the account or e-mail ("Please verify your account before you sign in", ...).

name: empty_text_none
spec: "none": empty text or anything else ("Sign In", "Loading", "Required", "Something went wrong").

name: loading_text_none
spec: "none": empty text or anything else ("Sign In", "Loading", "Required", "Something went wrong").

name: uppercase_account_locked_is_locked
spec: text = the error / alert messages the tenant shows (may be empty). Case-insensitive.

name: hedged_plus_definite_lock_is_locked
text: Your account might be locked. Your account has been locked.
spec: When a text contains both a definite lock and a hedged one, it is "locked".

name: long_password_first_retry
spec: "retry_long" — has_long is true and tried_long is false: sign in again with the long password first.

name: retry_long_beats_give_up
spec: Rules, in order; the first that holds wins: 1. "retry_long" — has_long is true and tried_long is false: sign in again with the long password first.

name: created_true_gives_up
spec: "give_up" — created is true (the account form was already tried once in this run; never a second time).

name: created_true_no_long_password_gives_up
spec: "give_up" — created is true (the account form was already tried once in this run; never a second time).

name: old_account_other_mail_before_agent_since
spec: "old_account" — there is an "other" mail dated before agent_since and no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since: the candidate's own old account, which the Keychain passwords do not open → hand to the candidate, do NOT create an account.

name: other_mail_equal_to_agent_since_is_not_before
spec: a mail dated before it is the candidate's own earlier activity; a date equal to agent_since counts as on/after it. / "create" — otherwise: there is probably no account on this tenant → open Create Account.

name: verify_mail_equal_to_agent_since_blocks_old_account
spec: "old_account" — there is an "other" mail dated before agent_since and no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since ... / a date equal to agent_since counts as on/after it.

name: verify_mail_after_agent_since_blocks_old_account
spec: "old_account" — there is an "other" mail dated before agent_since and no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since ... 4. "create" — otherwise: there is probably no account on this tenant → open Create Account.

name: verify_mail_before_agent_since_still_old_account
spec: "old_account" — there is an "other" mail dated before agent_since and no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since: the candidate's own old account ... do NOT create an account.

name: no_mails_creates_account
spec: "create" — otherwise: there is probably no account on this tenant → open Create Account.

name: only_verify_mail_on_agent_since_creates
spec: "create" — otherwise: there is probably no account on this tenant → open Create Account. / a date equal to agent_since counts as on/after it.

name: other_mail_after_agent_since_only_creates
spec: "old_account" — there is an "other" mail dated before agent_since and no "verify" mail dated on or after agent_since ... 4. "create" — otherwise: there is probably no account on this tenant → open Create Account.

name: long_password_already_tried_no_mails_creates
spec: "create" — otherwise: there is probably no account on this tenant → open Create Account.
